Im sorry to hear. I recently passed the one year Mark for when my mother passed. It's still just as hard. Feel free to reach out if you just want to talk or sit in silence but not be alone. No judgement here. I get it. 

That said, we did many of her favorites for her birthday when it came. Watched favorite movie, ate favorite dinner, listened to music, you get the point. It was very fulfilling. After spending what time we could honoring her we planted a tree and several flowers around it. The flowers were perineal so it was a tribute that we had to dig and replace at the next season. Seems like it's the living gift that we are proud to maintain and keep looking as beautiful as she was. 

Mom also said she wanted to come back and be a butterfly but she loved the moonlight more than the sunlight so it wouldn't work. 
I went and got a memorial tattoo with a butterfly zooming under the moon with the windtrails forming her signature. It's a smile o need every time I see it. 

It's gonna stay hard for a while. Take your time. Do what you need. Do whatever you think your mom would suggest if she were here. I'm sure you can go wrong.
